analyst.summary: Gokaldas Exports had a difficult FY26: revenue was roughly flat (up only ~3%), but profit fell about 37% on margin compression and a jump in the tax rate, while debt rose sharply to help fund the newly approved amalgamation of BRFL Textiles. The promoters' own equity stake is small and almost entirely pledged, which limits their financial cushion. This combination of weaker earnings, rising leverage and a highly pledged promoter position is a real governance and balance-sheet risk that is not yet fully visible in standard trailing ratios.
